# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and broader platform support. It introduces SKPathBuilder, color font palettes, CICP color spaces, configurable surface sampling, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. This preview also raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8 and removes 32-bit Tizen assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later before upgrading. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **32-bit Tizen native assets are removed** — The tizen-arm and tizen-x86 native packages are no longer produced after the Skia m147 update. Move Tizen deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion info uses GR casing** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Replace GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo references with the GR-cased type; the compatibility type no longer provides its former equality members. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.147.0.0** — SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.147.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks when adopting the v4 preview. ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m147** — The bundled engine brings newer image orientation, HDR and wide-gamut processing, color-aware filters, and accumulated raster and filter correctness fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Bundled image and font libraries are refreshed** — Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream releases. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for querying variation axes, cloning at design coordinates, selecting color palettes, and overriding palette entries. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPathBuilder supports immutable Skia paths** — The new builder wraps path mutation after upstream Skia made SKPath immutable; existing mutation methods remain available as obsolete compatibility APIs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData() exposes cheaply available backing data without an intermediate managed copy. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New rendering, document, GPU, and color-space controls** — Adds SKSamplingOptions surface draws, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, SKDocument.CreateXps, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, and SKMaskFilter.CreateShader. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Default typefaces initialize safely on Android** — Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager and falls back to an empty typeface instead of crashing during startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization no longer races its builder** — Disposal avoids flushing an SKPathBuilder after finalization has begun, preventing a native crash when the builder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches** — Reattached GL views retain their current dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface and rendering blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Font span APIs handle undersized buffers correctly** — Variation and palette queries retry all-or-nothing native calls safely, and ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses into a StackOverflowException. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64** — Dedicated linux-bionic runtime assets support Linux environments based on Android's Bionic libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen gains 64-bit native assets** — Adds tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 packages while the m147 engine transition retires the 32-bit Tizen targets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload** — Versioned library TFMs no longer require Xcode 26.2, while app projects select the workload installed on the build machine. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor for correct hb_color_t channel handling, and ships Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
